messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error rate: 7.3% over 3m. Pager routed to oncall-engineering-us-west. Runbook: investigate model variant hot path and recent deploys.
Maya Rao: i'm oncall, seeing the alert in grafana. starting with quick mitigation.
Sam Choi: thanks maya. any immediate customer-facing impact?
Maya Rao: early check — 4 active tenants have elevated error counts, roughly 10-15% of their requests failing. not seeing auth/403s.
Eli Jenkins: copying logs from api-router: ``504 downstream_proxied`` spikes aligned with higher latency on runtime-gpu-2.
Priya Nanda: tagging ops — could be overloaded instances or a regression in batching.
Maya Rao: mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to replica pool (model-variant: small-1) 2) temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 8 on runtime-gpu-2 3) scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes if needed. doing step 1 now.
Maya Rao: /run: rcli route-set --service inference --region us-west-2 --fallback small-1 :point_right: executing
incident-bot: command accepted. fallback routing active. traffic split: primary 80% -> small-1, 20% -> original.
Sam Choi: after fallback, error rate dropped to 1.2% in the last 90s. latency back to baseline for most requests. :thumbsup:
Carla M.: customer comms — do we need to notify affected tenants? which ones?
Maya Rao: list of affected tenants: acme-inc, brightapps, eduflow, lexicore. impact window ~5:02-5:28 UTC. severity: degraded but partial, not full outage.
Priya Nanda: recommend outbound note to the 4 tenants with timing + mitigation actions and promise postmortem. I'll draft once we have RCA.
Eli Jenkins: quick confirm — no evidence of data loss or compromised keys. KMS logs normal.
Maya Rao: moving to triage: initial hypothesis: model-variant kernel regression triggered under specific sequence lengths causing high KV cache eviction and downstream 504s.
Sam Choi: can we capture a small repro? any config diffs w/ last deploy at 4:48 UTC?
Maya Rao: deploys: model-optimizer image updated at 4:45 by ci-cd. I collected the rollout tags and logs.
Maya Rao: proposing post-incident workflow: schedule 1h postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC, owners: Eli (infra), Maya (oncall), Priya (product). action items created in thread below. please react with :white_check_mark: if that time works.
Carla M.: works for product.
Eli Jenkins: works for infra.
Sam Choi: ok for eng.
Maya Rao: ACTION 1: Create structured postmortem doc with timeline, root cause hypothesis, impact table, and remediation plan. Owner: Maya Rao. Size: 4h. Priority: P1 (must ship next sprint).
Maya Rao: ACTION 2: Roll back optimizer image on runtime-gpu-2 and run canary test across 10% traffic for 2 hours. Owner: Eli Jenkins. Size: 6h (includes monitoring). Priority: P1.
Maya Rao: ACTION 3: Add load-shedding at proxy layer to fail fast on 95th+ latency to avoid 504 cascades. Owner: Sam Choi. Size: 2d. Priority: P2 (quarterly safety workstream candidate).
Maya Rao: ACTION 4: Create prompt/sequence-length-based regression tests in model-onboarding. Owner: Priya Nanda. Size: 3d. Priority: P2, but tie to Q2 roadmap for model-safety.
Maya Rao: ACTION 5: Customer comms draft + support playbook for affected tenants. Owner: Carla M. Size: 2h. Priority: P1 for immediate outreach.
Sam Choi: I'm creating tickets now: INF-827 (rollback + canary), INF-828 (proxy shed), INF-829 (regression tests). linking in doc.
incident-bot: INF-827 created: https://redwood.example/issue/INF-827
incident-bot: INF-828 created: https://redwood.example/issue/INF-828
incident-bot: INF-829 created: https://redwood.example/issue/INF-829
Maya Rao: Next steps: 1) Eli executes rollback canary (INF-827) 2) Priya starts regression test spec (INF-829) 3) Sam drafts proxy changes (INF-828) 4) Carla sends client notes after postmortem doc ready.
Priya Nanda: estimating regression tests might find other edge cases — request to add to Q2 safety epic if confirmed.
Carla M.: i'll send a short note to support + affected customers now, marking 'investigating' with ETA for postmortem.
Maya Rao: thanks team — error rate stabilized, monitoring set to elevated alerting for 24h. will post the meeting invite and link to postmortem doc in this thread. closing active pager.
incident-bot: Pager closed by Maya Rao at 05:34 UTC.
Maya Rao: meeting invite: Postmortem: us-west-2 /v1/generate spike — 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, RCA, action items, owner commitments. link: https://zoom.example/meet/pm-1793004321
Sam Choi: quick note on prioritization: INF-827 and INF-829 -> sprint 1. INF-828 -> spike + spec sprint 2 with Q2 alignment.
Eli Jenkins: assigning myself INF-827 now. will post canary results in this thread.
Carla M.: added initial customer message to support tracker.
Maya Rao: final: please add any additional findings to the doc before the meeting. thanks all.
Sam Choi: :heart: good job on the quick mitigation everyone.
